observations.body: Jonathan strengthens David’s hand in God and renews covenant; Ziphites report David, Saul closes in, and a Philistine raid interrupts the pursuit.

payload.posture: Read 1 Samuel 23:15–29 as its own flight, covenant, and restraint David setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places David escapes while friendship and external crisis cross Saul’s pursuit inside this David setting without explaining every motive, transition, or later consequence.
